import itertools, json, os
import networkx as nx

def odd_power3(G):
    F=nx.Graph(); F.add_nodes_from(G)
    for v in G:
        ends=set(G[v])
        for a in G[v]:
            for b in G[a]:
                ends.update(G[b])
        F.add_edges_from((v,w) for w in ends)
    return F

def universal(k):
    vs=[x for x in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=k) if x.count(0)==1 and 1 in x]
    H=nx.Graph(); H.add_nodes_from(vs)
    for x,y in itertools.combinations(vs,2):
        if all(abs(a-b)==1 or a==b==2 for a,b in zip(x,y)): H.add_edge(x,y)
    return H

def hom_from_odd_coloring(G,col,k):
    # Coordinates: 0 for own color, 1 if neighbor has color, otherwise2
    return {v:tuple(0 if col[v]==i else 1 if any(col[w]==i for w in G[v]) else 2 for i in range(k)) for v in G}

stats=[]
for k in range(2,7):
    H=universal(k)
    assert nx.triangles(H) and not any(nx.triangles(H).values())
    stats.append((k,len(H),H.number_of_edges()))
count=0

    if not active: continue
    col=nx.coloring.greedy_color(Fa,strategy='largest_first'); k=max(col.values())+1
    f=hom_from_odd_coloring(Ga,col,k)
    for u,v in Ga.edges:
        assert all(abs(a-b)==1 or a==b==2 for a,b in zip(f[u],f[v]))
    count+=1
print('Universal trianglefree targets (k,vertices,edges):',stats)
